title: Birth, parents from Barbados and siblings
summary: Haynes gives his birth, his parents' names and Barbadian origin, and his three brothers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Roy Owen Haynes, Boston, Massachusetts, March 13th, 1925.
If you could tell us your father’s full name, your mother’s full name.
My father was Gus Haynes. My mother was – her maiden name was Payne – Edna Gertrude Payne.
What city in Barbados were they from?
What city? I think Barbados is the city. I think they call them parish – I think St. John.
Douglas Haynes. That was the oldest brother. Vincent Haynes. Douglas was born in Barbados. Vincent Haynes was born in Boston. Roy Haynes, Boston. Michael Haynes, Boston. He’s the youngest.
So you were the second or third?
